10-101 State Minimum Fire Safety Standards REREKRAERKEERRRKREAREKKEKERERRREREK
1:
The State Minimum Fire Safety Standards shall have state-wide effect and shall not require adoption by the City of Danielsville. The City of Danielsville is authorized to enforce these standards on all buildings and structures except one-family and two-family dwellings and those structures listed in O.C.G.A. § 25-2-13. Notwithstanding any other provision of law or any local ordinance to the contrary, in the event of a conflict between any code or standard of the National Fire Protection Association (National Fire Code and National Electric Code) and of the Standard Building Code Congress (Southern Standard Building Code), the code or standard of the National Fire Protection Association (National Fire Code and National Electric Code) shall prevail. The order of precedence established by this subsection shall apply to all buildings and structures whether or not such buildings and structures are covered under this Code section.
